description: LE-18: `(* (vector 1 2) 2)` — a vector/tensor against a scalar — is a diagnosed, located, catchable type error with exit 1, not a fatal SIGSEGV. Element-wise arithmetic used to select its kernel from the LEFT operand alone, so the Scheme-vector kernel read the integer 2 as a vector and dereferenced 2+8: SIGSEGV at 0xa, exit 139, no diagnostic and no source location. The `run_stderr_forbidden` entries are the crash's own signature, so a regression to the signal cannot pass; `MUST-NOT-PRINT` pins that nothing after the failing form runs.

runtime_diagnostics.contains: Type error in tensor-mul: expected tensor, got integer
